title: An element of a local projective module lies in a free summand
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring (a commutative ring with a unique maximal ideal), let $P$ be a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], and let $x\in P$. There exist submodules $G,H\subseteq P$ such that $P=G\oplus H$, $x\in G$, and $G$ is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Here $P=G\oplus H$ means that every element of $P$ has a unique expression $g+h$ with $g\in G$ and $h\in H$. No finite-generation hypothesis is imposed on $P$ or $G$.
